query:
INSERT INTO shares (name, description, pool, volume, recycle_bin, quota_bytes, compression, record_size,
                                   created_at, updated_at, shared, permissions_migrated_at)
               VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?8, ?9, ?9, ?10, ?9)
               ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
               RETURNING id AS "id!"
